correctness.rationale: Postnikov's lattice-covolume normalization gives volume (n+1)^(n-1) for the regular type-A_n permutohedron. The toric intersection dictionary multiplies this volume by n! to obtain projective degree. The braid fan has one maximal cone and one torus fixed point for each permutation in S_(n+1), so Euler characteristic is (n+1)!. The quotient is exactly (n+1)^(n-2), proving the complete crossover.

value.rationale: The standard permutohedral polarization is a canonical type-A toric embedding. Its degree is governed by Cayley's tree count while its Euler characteristic is governed by permutations/Weyl chambers. The theorem turns these two classical combinatorial models into an exact cross-invariant ratio and a complete dimensional phase diagram, with the degree-six del Pezzo surface as the unique equality case.
